features.name: Demonic Restoration
features.text: If the abveku dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.text: The abveku has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: The abveku makes four Scything Claw attacks and uses Mesmerizing Dance if available.

features.name: Scything Claw
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +11, reach 10 ft. Hit: 19 (3d8 + 6) Slashing damage.

features.name: Mesmerizing Dance
features.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature within a 20-foot Emanation originating from the abveku. Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

features.name: Shadow Stealth
features.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the abveku takes the Hide action.

features.name: Parry
features.text: Trigger: The abveku is hit by a melee attack roll. Response: The abveku adds 5 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

features.name: Legendary Resistance
features.text: If the sarrukh fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.text: The sarrukh has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: The sarrukh makes three attacks, using Trident or Necrotic Spit in any combination.

features.name: Trident
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 33 (6d8 + 6) Piercing damage.

features.name: Necrotic Spit
features.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +12, range 90 ft. Hit: 11 (2d10) Poison damage plus 22 (4d10) Necrotic damage.

features.name: Venomous Teleport
features.text: The sarrukh teleports up to 120 feet to an occupied space it can see, and each creature within 10 feet of the space the sarrukh leaves or arrives in (sarrukh's choice) is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20. Failure: 22 (4d10) Poison damage. Success: Half damage.

features.name: Shape Control
features.text: Trigger: A creature the sarrukh can see shape-shifts. Response: The sarrukh chooses the resulting form from among the options available to the shape-shifting creature or prevents the creature from shape-shifting.

features.name: Demonic Restoration
features.text: If the rendelith dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into gravel, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.text: The rendelith has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Siege Monster
features.text: The rendelith deals double damage to objects and structures.

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: The rendelith makes two Stone Hammer attacks and uses Spellcasting to cast Shatter (level 6 version).

features.name: Stone Hammer
features.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +13, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 21 (4d6 + 7) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition. If the target already has the Prone condition, it instead takes an extra 7 (2d6) Bludgeoning damage. Hit or Miss: The hammer magically returns to the rendelith's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

features.name: Quick Fortifications
features.text: The rendelith uses Spellcasting to cast Move Earth or Wall of Stone.

features.text: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, one creature the sarrukh can see within 30 feet. Failure: 18 (4d8) Psychic damage, and the target has the Frightened condition. Success: Half damage only.

features.name: Slither
features.text: The sarrukh moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and it makes one Bite attack.

features.name: Twisted Transformation
features.text: The sarrukh uses Spellcasting to cast Polymorph, and if the target fails its saving throw, the target also has the Stunned condition until the end of its next turn. The sarrukh can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

features.name: Legendary Resistance
features.text: If Szass Tam fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

features.name: Spirit Jar
features.text: If destroyed, Szass Tam re-forms in 1d10 days if he has a spirit jar, reviving with all his Hit Points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within Szass Tam's lair.

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: Szass Tam makes three attacks, using Paralyzing Touch or Soul-Draining Ray in any combination. He can replace two attacks with a use of Spellcasting to cast Finger of Death.

features.name: Paralyzing Touch
features.text: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (3d6 + 6) Cold damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the start of Szass Tam's next turn.

features.name: Soul-Draining Ray
features.text: Ranged Attack Roll: +13, range 120 ft. Hit: 25 (3d12 + 6) Necrotic damage, and the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Deathly Teleport
features.text: Szass Tam teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see, and each creature within 10 feet of the space he left takes 13 (3d8) Necrotic damage.

features.name: Disrupt Life
features.text: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 21, each creature that isn't an Undead in a 20-foot Emanation originating from Szass Tam. Failure: 14 (4d6) Necrotic damage and the creature's Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: Szass Tam can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

features.name: Regional Effects
features.text:
Szass Tam extends his presence into the region he inhabits, creating the following effects:

- **Soul Siphon.** Whenever a Humanoid dies within the lair, its soul is immediately consumed by Szass Tam. A Humanoid whose soul is consumed in this way can be brought back to life only by a True Resurrection or Wish spell.
- **Whispers of Necromancy.** Whenever a creature within 1 mile of the lair casts a Necromancy spell, Szass Tam knows the spell and the identity of the creature that cast it.

If Szass Tam is destroyed or moves his lair elsewhere, these effects end immediately. These effects resume if Szass Tam gains a new body (see his Spirit Jar trait).

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.text: Szass Tam casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 21, +13 to hit with spell attacks):

spellcasting.name: Protective Magic
spellcasting.text: Szass Tam casts Counterspell or Shield in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

spellcasting.name: Withering Magic
spellcasting.text: Szass Tam casts Blight or Dispel Magic, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

features.name: Evocation Sculptor
features.text: When Thrul casts a spell that creates an area of effect, she can choose herself and up to five other creatures she can see, sculpting the spell's energy around them. A chosen creature automatically succeeds on its saving throw against the spell, and it takes no damage if it would normally take half damage on a successful save.

features.name: Magic Resistance
features.text: Thrul has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

features.name: Multiattack
features.text: Thrul makes four Arcane Burst attacks. She can replace two attacks with a use of Spellcasting to cast Fireball (level 5 version) or Lightning Bolt (level 5 version).

features.name: Arcane Burst
features.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +11, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 32 (5d10 + 5) Force damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
spellcasting.text: Thrul casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 19):

spellcasting.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
spellcasting.text: Thrul casts Counterspell or Shield in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
